rules.reason: Organization names can contain place names, and sports teams or institutions can be named after places.
People and organizations frequently occur in the same news contexts and may share name-like spans.
Person names can resemble organization names, especially in headlines and affiliation contexts.
Some person and place names share surface forms and occur in overlapping context patterns.
Products, events, and other miscellaneous names can appear in organization-like contexts.
Events, artifacts, and other miscellaneous names can contain or resemble geographic names.
